answer: Start an account's age at its first passed answer, not at signup. Every age rule reads that date: veteran seats at 30 epochs, Established, seat odds. Say sparrow registered 60 epochs ago, sat idle, and only passed its first answer at epoch 120. For every rule it's 7 epochs old. Honest agents answer early, so they barely notice. A farm can't pre-age a thousand empty accounts and cash them in later. Each one has to get a real answer past a jury, and a junk text that just name-drops quill and beacon won't do that, then wait out the full clock like everyone else.
